marker.coordinate_definition: The physical reference coordinate is the square's geometric center, manually aligned to the pen-tip projection. Only one red square is visible for each capture.

capture_method.pipeline: One-shot direct pyrealsense2 capture, depth aligned to color at 640x480 RGB and depth, 30 fps.
capture_method.reason: A stale dashboard worker and short direct captures produced non-stable RGB exposure. The v3 method discards the first 90 frames before every observation.

coordinate_convention.origin: The physical P0 mark on the paper plane.
coordinate_convention.x_positive: The previously verified GRBL X+ physical direction.
coordinate_convention.y_positive: The previously verified GRBL Y+ physical direction.
coordinate_convention.motion_precheck: From P0, commanded X+30 mm measured 30 mm physically; commanded Y+30 mm measured 30 mm physically.

reference_generation.p0: After the COM4 interruption, the pen tip was manually realigned to physical P0 with 12 V disconnected, then the red square center was aligned to the pen tip before capture.
reference_generation.x30_y0: From physical P0, one persistent COM4 session executed six X+5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.
reference_generation.x30_y30: From physical X30Y0, one persistent COM4 session executed six Y+5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.
reference_generation.x0_y30: From physical X30Y30, one persistent COM4 session executed six X-5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.

status: v3 fit points and two independent validation points captured with 90-frame exposure warmup; fit and error review pending.
